editor_note: All four rewritten entries (14, 15, 16, 19) keep the English meaning, and none of them would mislead a learner. For example, "Reduza a sobrecarga de amostragem do cancelamento probabilístico de erros (PEC)" and "um observável alvo que absorveu informações do modelo de ruído" are faithful. There are two consistency problems. The "Browse documentation" link text is "Ver documentação" in entry 16 but "Navegar pela documentação" in entry 19 (and in entry 7). Entry 19 also uses "valores esperados" for "expectation values", while the rest of the page (entries 12, 17, 18, 30) uses "valores de expectativa".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The limits on broadcasts and bits (300 vs 2400, the 32-bit operand, no nested conditionals, store values not returned) all carry over correctly, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The problems are naturalness. "mid-circuit measurement" is calqued everywhere as "medição de meio-Circuit" where a native writer would say "medição no meio do circuito". "While these are early days" becomes the literal "primeiros dias de entender". "broadcast" is kept in English as a noun but becomes "transmitir/retransmitido" as a verb. In [57], "Add back together" is rendered as "Some novamente" ("sum again"), and "Measurement bases addon utility" loses "bases".

examples.source: measure qubits in the middle ... based on the outcome of those mid-circuit measurements. ... While these are early days of understanding how best to take advantage
examples.translation: com base no resultado dessas medições de meio-Circuit. ... Embora ainda estejamos nos primeiros dias de entender como melhor aproveitar
examples.suggested: com base no resultado dessas medições no meio do circuito. ... Embora ainda estejamos no início da compreensão de como aproveitar melhor
examples.why: 'medições de meio-Circuit' and 'primeiros dias de entender' are calques of the English. A Portuguese technical writer would phrase both differently.

examples.source: 3. Add back together the results for each partition.

examples.suggested: 3. Combine (some) os resultados de todas as partições.
examples.why: 'Some novamente' reads as 'sum again', but the step means recombining the per-partition results.

examples.suggested: Veja o módulo [`measurement_bases` do utilitário addon de bases de medição]
examples.why: 'bases' is dropped and 'Medição' is oddly capitalized, so the name of the utility is garbled.

examples.source: A broadcast is a transfer of unique classical data, and broadcasted bits is the number of classical bits being transferred.
examples.translation: Um broadcast é uma transferência de dados clássicos únicos, e os bits transmitidos correspondem ao número de bits clássicos sendo transferidos.
examples.suggested: Use one rendering consistently, e.g. keep 'broadcast' and write 'bits de broadcast'
examples.why: The noun stays in English as 'broadcast' but the verb forms become 'transmitir/retransmitido'. This hides that both refer to the same technical concept.

editor_note: Nothing in the 59 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The negations, caveats and examples all match the English: the precedence rule for twirling shots, the PEA/PEC explicit-learning requirement, the TREX exception, the [A, C]/[B] regrouping example and the ConvertISAToClifford layout and parameter consequences are all intact. A native editor would still smooth a few calques. "exercitar a etapa de aprendizado de ruído contra um backend falso" copies English test jargon. "disponha o observável" is an odd rendering of "lay out", where "aplique o layout ao observável" is the usual phrasing. "Os parâmetros são vinculados e removidos" is a stiff way to say "bound away". The register uses "você" throughout, and the terms stay consistent (lado do cliente/servidor, aprendizado de ruído, job, shots, PUB).

examples.suggested: então não é possível testar a etapa de aprendizado de ruído com um backend falso
examples.why: 'exercitar ... contra' is a literal calque of English testing jargon; Brazilian technical writers would say 'testar ... com'.

editor_note: Entry 60 is faithful and natural: "cobre o **conteúdo do tutorial** (escrito pela IBM)" matches the English, and "abra uma issue no GitHub" keeps "issue", which Portuguese developers normally leave in English.

Entries 20 and 21 are faithful and natural ("Amplificar o ruído do circuito para vários fatores de ruído", "Executar cada circuito com ruído amplificado"). Entry 74 renders "Pauli-twirled" and "twirled" as "com entrelaçamento de Pauli". In Portuguese "entrelaçamento" means entanglement, and this page also uses it that way ("camada de entrelaçamento" in entry 48), so a learner would read it as "a noise model with Pauli entanglement". That is a false concept, because twirling randomizes the noise into a Pauli channel and has nothing to do with entanglement. The same wording also makes the sentence read as if the layers themselves were entangled "with Pauli", and the qualifier is awkwardly repeated. Use "twirling de Pauli" or "aleatorização de Pauli" instead.

examples.source: after learning the Pauli-twirled noise model for layers of twirled two-qubit basis gates
examples.translation: após aprender o modelo de ruído com entrelaçamento de Pauli para camadas de portas de base de dois qubits com entrelaçamento de Pauli
examples.suggested: após aprender o modelo de ruído com twirling de Pauli para camadas de portas de base de dois qubits submetidas a twirling
examples.why: 'Entrelaçamento' means entanglement, and the page uses it that way elsewhere. Rendering 'twirled' this way would make a learner believe the noise model or layers involve Pauli entanglement, which is a false concept (twirling is randomized conjugation by Pauli operators).

examples.source: Pauli-twirled noise model for layers of twirled two-qubit basis gates
examples.translation: modelo de ruído com entrelaçamento de Pauli para camadas de portas ... com entrelaçamento de Pauli
examples.suggested: modelo de ruído com twirling de Pauli para camadas de portas de base de dois qubits submetidas a twirling
examples.why: The phrase 'com entrelaçamento de Pauli' is repeated verbatim, which reads clunky. The English says 'Pauli-twirled' only once, then 'twirled'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the appendix conditions: geometric separation of order √N, and classical complexity of order N against a quantum-projected complexity substantially smaller than N. Core terms are used consistently (kernel quântico projetado, matrizes de densidade reduzidas/1-RDMs, mapa de características, valores esperados, mitigação de erros). There are two small things to fix. The workflow step headings switch terms partway through, with "Etapa 1"/"Etapa 2" followed by "Passo 3"/"Passo 4". Entry [46] also adds "real" to "hardware quântico", which the English does not say.

examples.source: Step 3: Execute using Qiskit primitives
examples.translation: Passo 3: Executar usando primitivas do Qiskit
examples.suggested: Etapa 3: Executar usando primitivas do Qiskit (and 'Etapa 4' in [50]), matching 'Etapa 1'/'Etapa 2' in [27]/[33]
examples.why: The same 'Step N' heading series uses 'Etapa' for steps 1-2 and 'Passo' for steps 3-4, so the numbered workflow reads inconsistently.

examples.source: We also provide the results from an experiment that we ran on quantum hardware.
examples.translation: Também disponibilizamos os resultados de um experimento que executamos em hardware quântico real.
examples.suggested: Também disponibilizamos os resultados de um experimento que executamos em hardware quântico.
examples.why: 'real' is added. It is true in context and harmless, but the source does not say it.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The fidelity figures (0,82 vs 0,98, 0,65 at 50 sites), the segment counts (3+2 / 6+4), the estimator_options caveat about replacing defaults "totalmente" rather than merging, and the reconnect and job-status instructions all match the English. The problems are consistency. "function template" alternates between "template de função" (entries 0, 27, 30, 31, 39) and "modelo de função" (6, 45, 58, 81). "neutron kick" alternates between "perturbação do nêutron" (25, 27) and "impulso do nêutron" (44, 47, 56). "handle" is left as "handle" in 40 but becomes "identificador" in 53 and 63. The pipeline labels are "PRÉ/PÓS" in 25–26 but stay "PRE → FUNCTION → POST" in 42 and 79, and the section is called "Configuração" in its heading but "Setup" in 47, 53 and 63. There is also a redundant calque in 20: "Perturbe-o com uma perturbação local".

examples.source: Compress and execute with the function template
examples.translation: Comprimir e executar com o modelo de função
examples.suggested: Comprimir e executar com o template de função
examples.why: 'function template' is rendered as 'template de função' in 0, 27, 30, 31 and 39 but as 'modelo de função' here and in 6, 58 and 81. The page should pick one.

examples.source: then bake in the neutron kick
examples.translation: depois incorpore o impulso do nêutron
examples.suggested: depois incorpore o impulso do nêutron (and use 'impulso' in 25 and 27 too)
examples.why: Entries 25 and 27 call the same kick 'perturbação do nêutron', so the term changes partway through the page.

examples.source: Kick it with a local perturbation at the center site
examples.translation: Perturbe-o com uma perturbação local no sítio central
examples.suggested: Aplique-lhe um impulso local no sítio central
examples.why: 'Perturbe-o com uma perturbação' repeats the same root, a calque a native editor would rewrite. The fix also brings this entry in line with the 'impulso' used later.

examples.source: This validates the PRE → FUNCTION → POST pipeline
examples.translation: Isso valida o pipeline PRE → FUNCTION → POST
examples.suggested: Isso valida o pipeline PRÉ → FUNÇÃO → PÓS
examples.why: The table in 25 and the text in 26 translate the labels as PRÉ/FUNÇÃO/PÓS, but here and in 79 they stay in English.

editor_note: "Bare" (meaning without checks) is rendered as "puro" throughout ("payload puro", "circuitos puros"). In [63] this produces "estado ruidoso puro", which a learner reads as "noisy pure state". That clashes with the technical sense of "estado estabilizador puro" used in [12] and [22] and wrongly suggests the noisy output ρ is a pure state. Other issues are minor. "Check" is split between "checagens" ([0], [6], [8]), "verificações" (everywhere else) and the English "coherent Pauli checks"/"spacetime checks" kept in running text in [15] and [17]. "Commit a check" is calqued as "confirmar" (a git-style reading), and "Background" becomes "Histórico" instead of "Contexto".

examples.source: Now compare the fidelity of the bare noisy state with the postselected state.
examples.translation: Agora compare a fidelidade do estado ruidoso puro com o estado pós-selecionado.
examples.suggested: Agora compare a fidelidade do estado ruidoso sem verificações (sem pós-seleção) com a do estado pós-selecionado.
examples.why: 'puro' is the technical term for pure state (used that way in [12]/[22]); 'estado ruidoso puro' tells the learner the noisy mixed state is pure, which is false.

examples.source: Sample the bare payload and the checked circuits with Qiskit Aer.
examples.translation: Amostre o payload puro e os circuitos verificados com o Qiskit Aer.
examples.suggested: Amostre o payload sem verificações e os circuitos verificados com o Qiskit Aer.
examples.why: 'puro' for 'bare' collides with the quantum sense of 'pure'. The same rendering appears in [73] and [76] ('circuitos puros', 'circuito puro').

examples.source: The key difference between coherent Pauli checks and spacetime checks is the operators they measure.
examples.translation: A principal diferença entre coherent Pauli checks e spacetime checks são os operadores que medem.
examples.suggested: A principal diferença entre as verificações de Pauli coerentes (CPC) e as verificações espaço-temporais está nos operadores que elas medem.
examples.why: The English terms are left in running prose, while the same concept is 'checagens de Pauli espaço-temporais' in [0]/[6] and 'verificações' elsewhere, so 'check' has three renderings in one file.

examples.source: The package scores candidate checks against a noise model and commits the best ones to the circuit.
examples.translation: O pacote pontua as verificações candidatas em relação a um modelo de ruído e confirma as melhores no circuito.
examples.suggested: O pacote pontua as verificações candidatas com base em um modelo de ruído e incorpora as melhores ao circuito.
examples.why: 'confirmar' calques 'commit' in its git sense and is unclear here. The same calque recurs in [57], [66] and [76].

examples.source: Background
examples.translation: Histórico
examples.suggested: Contexto
examples.why: 'Histórico' means history/log; a section giving conceptual background is 'Contexto' or 'Fundamentação'.

editor_note: I found no change in meaning. The long caveat in [59] about filtering diagonal terms, the N vs n distinction in [20]/[23]/[29], and the claims about subspace size and pruning in [84]/[89]/[91] all say what the English says, and the core terms are used the same way throughout (porta, evolução temporal, estado fundamental, passe de transpilador, ansatz, bitstrings). Two word choices would bother a Portuguese editor. [88] uses 'autossolver' for 'eigensolver', which is not a standard Portuguese term. [93] calques 'C++ companion' as 'companheiro em C++'.

examples.source: the memory and cores available to the eigensolver
examples.translation: da memória e dos núcleos disponíveis para o autossolver
examples.suggested: da memória e dos núcleos disponíveis para o eigensolver (resolvedor de autovalores)
examples.why: 'autossolver' is not an established term. Readers would recognize 'eigensolver' or 'resolvedor de autovalores'.

examples.source: the [C++ companion] discusses this in more detail
examples.translation: o [companheiro em C++] discute isso com mais detalhes
examples.suggested: a [versão complementar em C++] discute isso com mais detalhes
examples.why: 'companheiro' calques 'companion'. A native technical writer would say 'versão complementar' or 'tutorial complementar'.
